description: Header file defining the MojoVideoEncodeAcceleratorService class, which implements the mojom::VideoEncodeAccelerator interface and manages video encoding acceleration using Mojo IPC in the Chromium media component.

classes.name: MojoVideoEncodeAcceleratorService
classes.description: Implements the mojom::VideoEncodeAccelerator interface, manages video encoding acceleration, and communicates with the underlying VideoEncodeAccelerator.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the video encoder with configuration, client, media log, and callback.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a video frame, with an option to force keyframe, and executes callback upon completion.

methods.name: UseOutputBitstreamBuffer
methods.description: Provides an output buffer for encoded bitstream data.

methods.name: RequestEncodingParametersChangeWithBitrate
methods.description: Requests change in encoding parameters with specified bitrate and framerate.

methods.name: RequestEncodingParametersChangeWithLayers
methods.description: Requests change in encoding parameters with specified bitrate allocation and framerate.

methods.name: IsFlushSupported
methods.description: Checks if flush operation is supported.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the encoder, executing callback when done.

methods.name: RequireBitstreamBuffers
methods.description: Client callback to require specific number of bitstream buffers.

methods.name: BitstreamBufferReady
methods.description: Callback indicating a bitstream buffer is ready with metadata.

methods.name: NotifyEncoderInfoChange
methods.description: Notifies about changes in encoder info.
